verdict.rationale: Docs mention session state, artifacts (persistent outputs beyond a conversation), and automatic summarization/filtering of conversational turns, implying some state persistence machinery, but there is no explicit documentation of a long-term memory service or cross-session/cross-thread memory store comparable to a dedicated memory API. missing for 10: explicit long-term memory API/service docs, cross-session and cross-thread persistence guarantees, examples of retrieving memory in new sessions, independent/hands-on confirmation.
